scope: Read-only vendor accuracy review of bilingual research Markdown and 11 connector JSON design profiles against primary-source vendor research notes; no hardware or API runtime validation
verified_design_guards: All 11 profiles declare adapter not_implemented and product version UNVERIFIED_AT_SITE
All profiles disable writes and have empty enabled_capabilities and tested_product_versions
All capability support values are unverified; limits and license evidence remain unset
Desigo and EBI OPC Classic are not misrepresented as OPC UA
EBI and WEBs are separated; Niagara local and NDS cloud are separated
Metasys API separate licensing and per-item batch results retained
WebCTRL outbound events not represented as universal REST point commands
Delta -API entitlement tied to dated catalog and current verification
EC-Net Supervisor not conflated with ECLYPSE controller REST

findings.issue: SOAP/JavaSDK combined wording implies case-specific licensing is documented for both. Primary sheet specifically applies case-by-case licensing to Java SDK.
findings.recommendation: State SOAP requires exact-version method contract; Java SDK licensing is case-by-case.

findings.issue: No explicit MVE exclusion retained from v4/Release12 source; generic product/version qualification remains safe but less specific.
findings.recommendation: Add version-qualified ADS/ADX/OAS scope and MVE exclusion for APIv4; do not extrapolate to all later releases without confirming contract.

findings.issue: Each capability repeats a product reference even when that page does not establish that method. No support is claimed because all entries are unverified.
findings.recommendation: Document refs as research context until exact method evidence is supplied; never use nonempty evidence_refs as activation proof.

limitations: Review does not assert source APIs were invoked or licenses purchased
Protocol correctness beyond vendor claims reviewed by separate protocol reviewer
Writer was updating files concurrently; corrections require final recheck
